adaptation_notes: The build fragment calls find_package(flecs CONFIG REQUIRED) and links flecs::flecs; its header is <flecs.h>, which brings the C++ API when included from C++.

Setup glue starts from ecs_os_set_api_defaults() and hands the bindings that table to fill in; it installs it with ecs_os_set_api and makes the one world in the systems phase, after the jobs phase has started the scheduler.

ecs_set_task_threads(world, am::jobs::workers()) runs the pipeline's extra stages as jobs. flecs's worker tasks block until the main thread releases them, so the stage count never exceeds the jobs workers; a game that asks for more stages than workers deadlocks.
Game code wraps the world with flecs::world(ctx.flecs.world) to use the C++ API, and never calls ecs_fini itself.
